name: Arnaud Ducret
bio:
Arnaud Ducret (born 6 December 1978) is a French actor and comedian.

In 2013, he plays Gaby alongside Alix Poisson (Isa) in Parents mode d'emploi, a series broadcast on France 2 that shows him a very large audience. The same year, he plays Eric in Serial Teachers and Serial Teachers 2.
